_note: Speaking and essay questions printed after each article in CEFR_Article_Book.pdf. Keyed by article number; the title is checked against the article so a reorder cannot misattach questions. Edit freely and rebuild.

1.title: Green Packaging
speaking: What do you usually do with packaging after you buy something?
Should shops be required to use only recyclable packaging? Why or why not?
Who should be most responsible for reducing waste: governments, companies or individuals?
1.essay: Some people believe that companies, not consumers, should pay the cost of recycling the packaging they produce. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

2.title: Too Much Traffic
speaking: How do you usually travel around your town or city, and why?
Why do so many people prefer driving to using public transport?
What would persuade you to leave the car at home?
2.essay: Some people think the best way to reduce traffic in cities is to make driving more expensive, for example through higher parking fees. Others believe better public transport is more effective. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

3.title: Bullying
speaking: What makes a school a safe and friendly place for students?
Why do you think some young people bully others?
What should a student do if they see someone being bullied?
3.essay: Some people say schools are responsible for preventing bullying, while others believe parents play the bigger role. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

4.title: Growing Old
speaking: What role do older people play in your family?
What can young people learn from older generations?
Is it better for elderly people to live with their families or in care homes? Why?
4.essay: In many countries people are living longer than ever before. What problems does this create for society, and what can be done to solve them?

5.title: Parental Aspirations
speaking: Did your parents influence your choice of studies or career? How?
Is university the best path for every young person? Why or why not?
How can parents support their children without putting too much pressure on them?
5.essay: Some parents believe their children must go to university to have a successful life. Others think practical skills and vocational training are just as valuable. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

6.title: Discrimination against Disability
speaking: How easy is it for a wheelchair user to get around your town or city?
Why do people sometimes treat disabled people differently, even without meaning to?
What changes would make public places more inclusive?
6.essay: Some people believe the government should spend much more on making public transport and buildings accessible to people with disabilities. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

7.title: Football Hooligans
speaking: Do you prefer watching sport live or on television? Why?
Why do some fans become violent at matches?
Should football clubs be punished for the behaviour of their fans?
7.essay: Some people think fans who behave violently at sporting events should be banned from all matches for life. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

8.title: Travel Troubles
speaking: Tell me about a journey that did not go as planned.
Is travelling abroad becoming easier or more stressful? Why?
What are the advantages of holidaying in your own country instead of abroad?
8.essay: More people than ever now travel abroad for their holidays. Do the benefits of international tourism outweigh the problems it causes?

9.title: New Research on Computer Games
speaking: How much time do you spend playing games or using screens each day?
Can computer games be good for children? In what ways?
Should parents limit how long their children play computer games?
9.essay: Some people think computer games harm children's development, while others believe games can help children learn. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

10.title: Terrorism
speaking: Where do you usually get your news, and how far do you trust it?
How has the way we hear about world events changed in recent years?
Why is international cooperation important for keeping people safe?
10.essay: Some people believe the media should limit its coverage of violent attacks so that attackers do not gain publicity. Others think the public has a right to full information. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

11.title: Healthy Eating
speaking: Describe a typical meal you eat during the week.
Why do many people find it hard to eat healthily?
Should schools teach students how to cook healthy food?
11.essay: Some people think governments should put a tax on unhealthy food and drinks to improve public health. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

12.title: Food Scares
speaking: Do you check where your food comes from before you buy it?
How far do you trust the information on food labels?
Is organic food worth the extra cost?
12.essay: Some people believe genetically modified food could help to end world hunger, while others think it is too risky. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

13.title: The Dangers of Passive Smoking
speaking: Is smoking common among people your age where you live?
Should smoking be banned in all public places, including outdoor areas?
How can young people be discouraged from starting to smoke?
13.essay: Some people think smoking should be banned completely because it harms not only smokers but also the people around them. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

14.title: A Donor Shortage
speaking: Have you ever donated blood, or would you consider it?
Why do you think many people are unwilling to become organ donors?
Should people be registered as donors automatically unless they choose not to be?
14.essay: In some countries everyone is automatically an organ donor unless they choose to opt out. Do the advantages of this system outweigh the disadvantages?

15.title: The Benefits of Chocolate
speaking: What is your favourite treat, and how often do you have it?
Why do people often feel guilty about eating sweet things?
Should sweets and chocolate be sold in schools?
15.essay: Some people say that advice about healthy eating changes so often that it is impossible to know what to believe. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

16.title: Climate Change
speaking: Have you noticed any changes in the weather where you live?
What everyday actions can people take to protect the climate?
Why do some people still not take climate change seriously?
16.essay: Some people think individuals can do little to stop climate change and that only governments and large companies can make a real difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

17.title: Endangered Species
speaking: Which wild animal would you most like to protect, and why?
Are zoos good or bad for endangered animals?
Why does it matter if a species disappears that most people never see?
17.essay: Some people argue that money spent on protecting endangered animals would be better spent on helping people. To what extent do you agree or disagree?

18.title: Modern Celebrities
speaking: Is there a famous person you admire? Why?
Why are so many young people interested in celebrities' private lives?
Do celebrities have a responsibility to be good role models?
18.essay: Today many people become famous without any particular talent or achievement. Is this a positive or a negative development?

19.title: The Right to Die
speaking: Why are some moral questions so hard for a society to agree on?
Who should make important medical decisions: patients, doctors or families?
Should laws change when public opinion changes?
19.essay: Some people believe that patients with incurable illnesses should have the right to make decisions about the end of their own lives, while others think this is too dangerous to allow. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

20.title: All Kinds of Rage
speaking: What kinds of situations make you feel stressed or annoyed?
Why do people seem to lose their temper more easily nowadays?
What are good ways to calm down when you feel angry?
20.essay: Some people believe that modern life is making people more stressed and aggressive. What are the causes of this, and what can be done about it?
